identity_rule: One immutable IB identity per canonical intelligence object.
archive_boundary_note: IB-000001 and IB-000002 are preserved as historical repository-only projections. Live receiver evidence shows no receiver-backed records for either ID; the production receiver currently begins at IB-000003. They are excluded from the active canonical registry and cannot be retrieved as live Intelligent Blocks.
identity_allocation_rule: The live canonical receiver allocates immutable IB IDs. Repository files, registry consumers, tests, scripts, and Nayas must never calculate, guess, increment, reserve, or assign an IB ID.
